description: 8 should-trigger + 6 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for verifying a new third-party dependency before install (existence/slopsquatting, pin+lock, CVE, no curl|bash) and for installing a foreign agent skill, plugin or mod (npx skills add, a repo link, a .skill/.zip archive). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (upgrading existing deps, secrets, generic checklist, server auth, writing a new skill of your own) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: add the package the model suggested to package.json and install it
is this pip package real or a hallucination before I install?
the install command is a curl piped to bash — is that safe?
prüf diese neue Abhängigkeit bevor ich sie installiere (existiert sie überhaupt?)
should I pin this dependency and commit a lockfile?
install this skill for me: npx skills add some-org/pdf-helper
someone sent me a repo link and said install this — it is a Claude plugin with hooks
hier ist ein .skill-Archiv aus dem Marketplace, kannst du es installieren?
upgrade our existing lodash to the latest major and fix breakages
rotate the API keys stored in our secret manager

review the authorization on this endpoint
